recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is needed for FHIR-24993 unless a future work-group issue intentionally changes the QuestionnaireResponse repeat model.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive FHIR-core QuestionnaireAnswers issue asking to clarify that repeated answers to a repeating question in QuestionnaireResponse use one question item with multiple answer elements, not multiple sibling question items each with one answer.
initial_application: Git commit 0aae65acbdcf90f2dbcc5ba3b0c0a8493f7c1d60 applied the issue by adding the QuestionnaireResponse.item comment that repeating group items use separate item repetitions while repeating questions use a single question item with potentially multiple answers. That clarification remains in the active source.
additional_context: The originating Zulip thread and FHIR SDC minutes support the Jira disposition. Later Published issue FHIR-33335 added qrs-2, an invariant saying repeated answers are combined in the answers array of a single item; FHIR-38853 refined adjacent group nesting wording without changing the repeated-question rule; and FHIR-55973 only added distinct-answer constraints.
reconciliation: No source change was made because source/fhir.ini lists QuestionnaireResponse as active and source/questionnaireresponse/structuredefinition-QuestionnaireResponse.xml already contains both the requested explanatory comment and the qrs-2 invariant that enforces the same representation.
